model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different models—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as a function of the number of completions, denoted as $k$. The x-axis, labeled “Number of completions ($k$)”, is logarithmic, spanning from $2^0$ to $2^5$, with tick labels at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled “Coverage”, is linear and ranges from 0.4 to 0.8. The blue line with solid circles represents Llama-3B, starting at a coverage of 0.4 at $k=2^0$ and rising to 0.8 at $k=2^5$. The green line with solid triangles represents Llama-3B + FT, beginning at 0.4 at $k=2^0$ and increasing to 0.8 at $k=2^5$. The light blue line with solid circles represents Llama-1B, starting at approximately 0.2 at $k=2^0$ and reaching about 0.8 at $k=2^5$. The light green line with solid triangles represents Llama-1B + FT, beginning at approximately 0.2 at $k=2^0$ and also reaching about 0.8 at $k=2^5$. All lines show a steady increase in coverage as $k$ increases, with the Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT lines consistently achieving higher coverage values than the Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT lines at earlier values of $k$.
